item.title: Related Ross Lands $173M Financing to Buy the Ben Hotel in West Palm Beach
item.description: Related Ross has acquired a luxury West Palm Beach, Fla., hotel using a $172.5 million loan from Nomura, according to Newmark. item.title: War in Iran Barely Fazes Markets as Investors Make Quick Corrections
item.description: Investors in public stock markets did something uncharacteristic Monday: They barely blinked following the weekend attacks on Iran led by the U.S. and Israel.
